verdict.rationale: Workers documents "built-in observability" for deep visibility into Worker applications, and Cloudflare runs a managed Observability MCP server, which touches application performance monitoring. Nothing in the evidence covers visitor-behavior analytics, though (page views, sessions, traffic sources), and the performance side is only a one-line marketing claim. Missing for 10: visitor/web analytics capability, documented site-performance metrics (latency, request rates, Core Web Vitals), dashboard or analytics docs depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
